methods.locality: Literal own P1976 active code in same stored state; otherwise exact full name ignoring case/accents and square/round bracket style, same state, <=1km, no second same-name code <=5km, using ITER and AGEEML names. Active U/R only. Withdrawn codes, wrong states and duplicates held.
methods.population: Only own ITER2020 POBTOT, never LOC0000/9998/9999; numeric count and name agree with active AGEEML before replacing undated/pre2010 population.
methods.municipality: Own P3801, own municipality class Q1952852, current code/state, no competing CSC owner and strictly interior unchanged point in hash-verified INEGI 2026 municipal polygons. Stored non-null population must equal official municipal total; otherwise held to avoid carrying seat counts.
methods.parents: Existing empty parent only, one level2 municipality proved by own P3801 or exact full municipal name in state.
methods.duplicates: Both IDs listed with unchanged canonical hashes for v7; counterpart outside 480 remains untouched.
methods.events: One reviewed identity/classification event per changed row, dynamic event_pr from applier --pr.
methods.format: In-place row replacements, canonical full-row guards on all 480, append-only source/events prefixes; TYPE_FIELD.md untouched.
